changed_fields.before: Urgent medical help; the live/self context can supply the affected person, while PERSON adds an explicit person referent.
changed_fields.after: Urgent medical help for oneself or another person; the form depends on the request and shared visible or written context.

changed_fields.before: In live/self-referential use, the interaction may supply who needs help. Adding PERSON makes a person referent explicit and can shift the reading toward someone specified or other than the speaker. This is context economy, not a first-person grammatical rule.
changed_fields.after: For this request, safety_medical + punct_exclaim is sufficient when asking for oneself, including written requests. It is also sufficient for another person in a shared visible situation when that person is explicitly pointed to. Use person_generic + safety_medical + punct_exclaim for another person outside shared visual contact, or in a written message about another person. The self-referential default belongs to use of this request; absence of PERSON is not a grammatical first-person pronoun.
